title: Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy Renewal and Nonrenewal Rules
content:
**R1. Renewal on payment.** A Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy in force is renewed for twelve calendar months when renewal installment 1 is paid by the expiration date; otherwise it expires with the status reason renewal not paid.

**R2. Liability claim frequency.** The umbrella is not renewed when the household's count of liability claims paid in the lookback has reached the tier's liability claims figure on the renewal offer date; the notice of nonrenewal must be sent at least the tier's nonrenewal notice period before expiration, and the umbrella then expires with the status reason liability claim frequency.

**R3. Residence policy.** An umbrella whose required residence policy is no longer live at the renewal offer date is not renewed.

## Terms used in the rules

- **Renewal offer date.** The day the renewal is billed, which falls the tier's renewal billing lead time before expiration.
- **Liability claims count.** The liability claims paid for the household by any carrier in the lookback years ending on the renewal offer date, as disclosed on the application and on Larkspur claim records (liability claim entries on HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy, RentGuard Renters Policy and LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy claim files, and umbrella claim payments), each claim counted once. "Reached" means the count is equal to or above the tier figure.
- **Required residence policy.** The HomeGuard, CondoGuard or RentGuard policy insuring the named insured's primary residence. It is live when it is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal.

## Outcomes at the end of the term

| Situation | Outcome | Status reason |
|---|---|---|
| In force; renewal installment 1 paid on or before the expiration date; no nonrenewal ground | Renewed for twelve calendar months | None |
| In force; renewal installment 1 not paid by the expiration date | Expires | Renewal not paid |
| Claims count has reached the tier figure on the renewal offer date | Not renewed; notice of nonrenewal sent; expires | Liability claim frequency |
| Required residence policy no longer live at the renewal offer date | Not renewed | |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- **Payment boundary.** Expiration date 1 October: renewal installment 1 paid on 1 October is paid by the expiration date, and the umbrella renews for twelve calendar months to 1 October of the following year. Paid on 2 October, it is not; the umbrella has expired for renewal not paid.
- **Claims count.** On a tier figure of 2, a count of 1 on the renewal offer date does not bar renewal; a count of 2 does.
- **Notice timing.** Expiration date 1 October and a 30-day nonrenewal notice period: the notice of nonrenewal is sent on 1 September or earlier.
